expression: (http.request.method eq "POST") and ((http.request.uri.path eq "/login") or (http.request.uri.path eq "/signup") or (starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/api/auth/")))
notes: Rate-limit auth endpoints to 5 POSTs per IP per 60s. After threshold, the source IP is challenged for 10 minutes. POST /login, POST /signup, and POST /api/auth/* are covered. Tune the path list to match your real auth surface (e.g., /sign-in, /forgot-password). Free plan supports 1 rate-limit rule. For multi-tenant SaaS, switch the characteristic to ip.src + http.request.uri.path or use the Workers Rate Limiting binding for per-user keys.
